jobs.description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description The Senior Manager, U.S. Merchant Business Development is responsible for managing a portfolio of approximately 20-25 strategic merchant relationships across the industry verticals managed by the U.S. Merchant team. This role serves as a primary Visa relationship owner, responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding executive relationships, and aligning client priorities with Visa's broad portfolio of products and services. This position is well suited to an existing seller seeking to broaden their account ownership and selling experience, or to a commercially oriented professional with strong analytical or operational experience who is ready to transition into a front-line, client-facing sales role. In addition to an assigned portfolio, the Senior Manager will maintain and actively pursue a prioritized list of high-potential opportunities that emerge throughout the fiscal year. These opportunities may span multiple industries and revenue streams and require close partnership with internal stakeholders to advance and close. The Senior Manager will develop and execute account strategies that grow Visa payment volume and revenue through Visa products and value-added services, Debit Routing Agreements, co-brand opportunities, and Value-in-Kind engagements. This individual will represent Visa to client stakeholders, support commercial discussions, and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver client and Visa objectives. The role requires a proactive seller who can balance relationship management, pipeline development, and operational excellence while leveraging AI to improve sales productivity, portfolio management, and prioritization. Essential Functions The Senior Manager will: Serve as the primary Account Executive and relationship owner for a portfolio of approximately 20-25 strategic merchant clients. Maintain and actively pursue a prioritized list of high-potential prospects outside the assigned portfolio, qualifying and advancing opportunities based on revenue potential, strategic value, and likelihood of execution. Develop and execute account plans that strengthen client relationships, expand executive engagement, and drive revenue growth. Prioritize client opportunities and allocate time and resources based on revenue potential, strategic value, and likelihood of execution. Build relationships across client organizations, including payments, finance, treasury, loyalty, digital commerce, and technology teams. Lead or support the negotiation, execution, and ongoing management of commercial agreements, including Debit Routing Agreements and other strategic revenue-generating partnerships. Own the end-to-end management of Value-in-Kind (VIK) across applicable accounts, including opportunity identification, client engagement, execution, activation, and measurement of business outcomes. Prospect, qualify, and advance co-brand credit and debit opportunities in partnership with issuer and internal Visa stakeholders. Drive sales of Visa products, value-added services, consulting, data, risk, acceptance, and emerging commerce solutions, including agentic commerce. Build and maintain a robust pipeline of opportunities while meeting revenue, product adoption, and portfolio growth objectives. Maintain high-quality account, contact, pipeline, forecasting, and opportunity records within Microsoft Dynamics (MSD) and other sales management tools, ensuring strong data integrity and reporting accuracy. Utilize AI-enabled sales tools, automation, and data insights to improve prospecting, client engagement, portfolio coverage, pipeline management, and scalable programs such as VIK. Coordinate cross-functional account teams to deliver a seamless client experience and maximize the value of Visa's relationship with assigned accounts. Provide strategic client, industry, and competitive insights to Visa leadership and product teams. Travel up to 20% of the time, generally averaging approximately one client-facing trip per month. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD Preferred Qualifications: 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD Experience in strategic sales, business development, account management, relationship development, payments, or related client-facing commercial roles. Experience supporting merchants within one or more industries represented across the U.S. Merchant organization is a plus. Demonstrated success developing client relationships and contributing to revenue growth objectives. Strong understanding of the U.S. payments ecosystem, including merchants, issuers, acquirers, debit routing strategies, and co-brand programs. Experience negotiating and managing commercial agreements. Proven ability to develop pipeline, create business cases, and advance complex sales opportunities. Experience leveraging CRM, sales management, AI-enabled productivity, and analytics tools to improve sales effectiveness and portfolio performance. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills. Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities with the ability to translate client needs into commercial opportunities. Highly collaborative, self-motivated, and results-oriented with the ability to operate effectively in a matrixed organization. Proficiency in Microsoft Dynamics, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Information for US Applicants For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $153,700.00 to $ 246,200.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program. Work Hours Varies upon the needs of the department. Travel Requirements This position requires travel 5-10% of the time. Mental/Physical Requirements This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law, including the requirements of Article 49 of the San Francisco Police Code.

Who are we?
Tripledot
Studios
is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.
We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.
Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.
Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.
We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who
LOVE
making games.
Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.
The role is working within our studio: Belka Games
Belka Games
is a game development company. According to Sensor Tower, the company is among the top 30 highest-grossing game developers in Europe, and its audience has recently surpassed 110 million players.
Role Overview
We're looking for a Game Designer specialising in balance and economy to strengthen one of the core areas of a mature, live-ops-driven F2P project. The key goal is to rebuild the in-game economy and bring system-level rigour to how we balance live-ops — moving from point-by-point tuning of individual events toward a coherent, interconnected approach.
This is a hands-on, analytical role: you will dive into the data yourself to understand how the game behaves today, build the models and frameworks needed for balancing, and work in close partnership with the producer, game designers and analysts to take your decisions through to production.
Key Responsibilities
Diagnose the current state of the game economy through independent, hands-on data analysis
Systematically configure and maintain the in-game economy, including the monetisation layer
Design and tune live-ops balance — not only within individual events, but across the whole layer, accounting for how events interact with and influence one another
Establish a systematic workflow for live-ops balancing and an overall approach to rewards within events
Help shape the event calendar toward stronger synergy between events
Build and maintain balance models, documentation, charts and diagrams
Analyse balance and monetisation, and propose data-backed changes and improvements
Work with producer, game designers, level designers and analysts to validate and ship balance changes
Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
Senior or Lead-level experience in game design, game balance, or economy design on live F2P games
Strong understanding of F2P economies, including currencies, rewards, monetisation, offers, pricing, and player segmentation
Hands-on experience balancing progression, live-ops content and reward systems
Strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently with data using SQL and BI tools
Advanced Excel or spreadsheet modelling skills. Experience building economy simulations is a plus
Good understanding of statistics and A/B testing
Strong mathematical and systems-thinking skills
Ability to create clear, repeatable balancing frameworks and documentation
Experience with match-3, casual, puzzle, or other live-ops-heavy games is a plus
English and Russian spoken and written at B2 level and above

회사 소개
CFS (Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
쿠팡의 FC는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화 (Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.
CFS는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 “쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?” 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
프로세스 혁신(Process Innovation) 팀은 Coupang의 빠른 성장에 발맞춰 물류 운영 전반의 비용과 프로세스를 지속적으로 개선하는 역할을 수행합니다. 물류센터 운영 프로세스를 분석하고 최적화하여 생산성을 극대화하고, 물류 네트워크 설계, 자동화 도입, 공급망 혁신을 통해 운영 효율을 향상시키는 업무를 담당합니다. 데이터 기반 분석과 실험을 통해 개선 기회를 발굴하고, 이를 실행 가능한 전략으로 전환하여 비즈니스 성과 창출에 기여합니다.
업무 내용
물류센터(Fulfillment Center) 운영 프로세스 분석 및 생산성 향상 방안 도출
인력 운영 최적화 및 리드타임 단축을 통한 비용 절감 과제 발굴
전국 물류 네트워크 설계 및 센터 간 처리물량(Load Balancing) 최적화

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?
Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.
Senior Experience Planning & Merchandising Associate Manager
San Mateo, CA (Hybrid)
Role overview:
Our team operates within the wider ‘Services Commercial’ group who are dedicated to growing PlayStation’s subscription services. This wider group strives to maximise new subscriber acquisition and retention and provide a compelling reason for people to return to the service year after year. Our product, PlayStation Plus, is critically important to PlayStation’s vision and strategy. PlayStation Plus is subscribed to by the majority of PlayStation users and has seen dynamic growth since re-launching with a multi-tiered proposition in 2022.
You will be joining the ‘Experience’ team – whose mission is to craft best-in-class customer experiences that foster an informed, engaged, and excited group of subscribers. What does that mean? Anywhere you find PlayStation Plus on a PlayStation console, or the PlayStation App, our team is determining what our customers see – the latest, the greatest, and the most relevant messages for each customer. We are responsible for both subscriber and non-subscriber experiences – maximising subscription purchases, tier upgrades, and engagement with service benefits. We optimize user experiences through continuous test and learn activity and bring ‘moments-that-matter’ to life through innovative merchandising.
As the
Senior
Experience Planning & Merchandising Associate Manager
, your primary responsibility will be to bring organization, structure, and a calm head to our planning process. We work closely with a wide array of stakeholders who have a variety of priorities - you will build bridges between cross-functional teams at PlayStation, executing both the long-term and monthly merchandising plans – helping us to prioritise the right activities and efforts. We can target messages to specific groups of customers – which can become complex quickly – if you see this as an enjoyable challenge to manage – you’re the right person for us!
You will leverage your expertise in digital merchandising and commerce to execute best-in-class campaigns on our console and app storefronts – ensuring strong visibility and communication across relevant stakeholders. You will also partner closely with Content and Engagement teams to build and maintain a calendar of editorial moments with complete support plans. You’ll review and optimize our processes that help us go-to-market, making sure that every time we do something it’s better with each iteration.
You will coordinate merchandising efforts across numerous touchpoints, including game releases into PlayStation Plus, Live Services moments, engagement events, promotions and seasonal moments. You will also help maintain our evergreen merchandising experiences such as content collections and benefit education pages – ensuring proper content inclusion and consistently fresh creative. Your hands-on approach will involve a significant amount of stakeholder alignment, trade-offs, and the ability to adapt plans as business needs change.
The Experience team are on a growth journey – We’re expanding our team significantly, and we want you to help us with that journey.

Develop and execute an Experience plan
:

Support the Merchandising team when interacting with the Content, Engagement, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to ensure that merchandising priorities are properly planned for.
Deliver on existing playbooks and processes to streamline planning and execution of our most common type of support and merchandising activity.

Performance, accountability, and continuous improvement
